messages:
Connor (Support): Heads-up — just got a support ticket from a large customer (ACME Corp). They want: streaming fncall/tool events with structured JSON outputs emitted incrementally, and each partial tool result must be delivered with <150ms tail latency. Ticket 82741.
Aisha (PM): Ack. Do they mean partial JSON chunks as the model computes, or discrete tool-call completions streamed one-by-one?
Connor (Support): They described both. Example flow: model triggers function A, we start streaming a JSON schema for A, then later function B, etc. They want client to process each tool-call's JSON as soon as it's available (no finalization wait).
Priya (Eng): That’s tricky — our current fncall streaming is optimized for text first; structured per-tool streaming + guaranteed small tail latency isn't supported out-of-the-box. Do we have a repro?
Connor (Support): Attached minimal repro from customer (pasted part here):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{ "stream": true, "messages": [...], "tool_mode": "fncall-stream" }
// client expects: {"tool":"A","payload":{...}, "chunked":true} events as they complete
```
Aisha (PM): Acceptance criteria idea: 1) server can emit tool-call start/partial/complete events as JSON chunks, 2) each event observable within 150ms after model step completes for 95th percentile, 3) SDK examples + contract doc, 4) fallback behavior for non-streaming clients. Thoughts?
Samir (ML): Two immediate constraints: 1) token-level streaming latency depends on batching and kernel schedules, 2) structured outputs often require finalization/validation. We can emit partial frames (best-effort), but to guarantee schema-valid JSON per chunk we might need model ops to emit pre-validated fragments.
Devon (SRE): From infra side, <150ms tail for every partial tool event is hard if continuous batching is on. We can offer a low-latency path (disable batching, route to hot-pool) for a premium tier, but that increases cost. Also need to consider concurrent connection scaling.
Priya (Eng): Implementation sketch: add a new route param `fncall_stream_mode = "per-tool-chunk"` that: disables multi-request batching for that connection, streams tool boundary tokens with explicit event envelopes, and provides a streaming schema header. Edge cases: model restarts, partial JSON merging, client reconnection.
Aisha (PM): Prioritization question: customer says this is blocking a pilot. Account exec flagged as high value. We should surface to roadmap if impact > 3 eng-weeks. Estimate?
Priya (Eng): Rough: design + API + SDK docs = 1w, runtime changes + hot-path low-latency mode = 3-4w, testing + rollout = 1-2w. So ~6-7w for an initial beta. Could be less with a hacky fallback (webhook per tool call) as interim.
Samir (ML): Possible alternate: do server-side post-processing to assemble per-tool structured payload and push as a single quick event when available. That reduces streaming semantics but meets latency for some flows. Tradeoff: client can't start processing partial JSON while model is still generating.
Connor (Support): Customer will accept a short-term webhook push if we promise roadmap for true per-chunk streaming. They explicitly prefer streaming though.
Aisha (PM): OK — proposed next steps: (1) Priya to create spec PR with API param and contract + sample cURL, (2) estimate spike to confirm kernel/latency impacts, (3) Prod to evaluate cost delta for hot-path routing, (4) present to GTM and CS for pilot commitment. Priya can you file the triage ticket? Tag: #customer-82741?
Priya (Eng): I'll spin up a spec PR today and include example SDK code and minimal server behavior. Will add a toggle flag so we can roll out to a subset.
Devon (SRE): I’ll draft the infra cost sketch and failure modes (reconnect, partial-repeat events). Also will add rate-limit considerations for per-chunk pushes.
Samir (ML): I'll run a microbenchmark on a couple of open models for streaming token latencies and share numbers. Expect ~20-60ms per token if batching disabled, but end-to-end app latency depends on other factors.
Connor (Support): Shared ticket with customer: https://support.acme.example/t/82741 — they added logs showing gaps in our current stream handling.
Aisha (PM): Cool. For prioritization: putting this as 'high' for pilot customers; move to roadmap if SRE cost is acceptable and spike looks promising. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Deployed docs site preview for spec PR #4212 to staging.
Priya (Eng): PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4212 — contains API draft and sample curl. Will link tests once spike completes.
Connor (Support): I'll keep ACME updated and offer the webhook fallback while engineering spikes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
